reviews.review:
This game is super simple - you just do what you normally do on your computer and the cat will poop in response to every keystroke and click! It's very similar to bongo cat in that you just set it up somewhere on your screen and the poop will fall to the bottom of your screen onto your task bar. It's really easy to rank up in points and get prizes as long as you're doing something on your computer, and there are a lot of cute skins and decorations. 

My only gripes would be that the poop pile does grow FAST - so if you're someone that plays games or has to type to work, it can get out of hand if you're not able to clear it immediately. That being said, there is an auto-clean mode that does it for you immediately, or a no poop mode. There's also things you can collect from the poop, but you can't do anything with them, so I'm not sure why that portion of the game exists. It'd be cute if you could use them as decor or skins. 

I've only just started playing a day or so ago, but I'm fascinated with it and absolutely love it. I'm really hoping there's a Sphynx skin I can unlock at some point! I have it sitting right next to my Bongo Cat, and it's made work so much more fun for me. 

Totally work the $1 something - I got it on sale, but even regular price is just $1.99. If you need something to liven up your desktop - this is it!
reviews.developer_response:
Heyyyy, thank you so much for your love and your valuable review!! 💖

The different poop rarities give players more chances to earn POOPS and unlock new treasures. We're planning to redesign the poop collection page to make it clearer and separate it from the other menus.

Even though we don’t have the Sphynx skin yet, we’ll make sure to add it in the next patch, which will be released in the middle of next week during the Animal Fest.
